components.name: Engine · Vulkan
components.description: GPU inference through Vulkan. Works on most Windows GPUs, including integrated graphics, and is the recommended default.

components.name: Engine · CPU
components.description: CPU-only inference. A fallback for machines with no usable GPU, and the smallest engine pack.

components.name: Engine · CUDA 12.4

build.reason: CUDA is gated on benchmarks showing Vulkan underperforms. See RELEASE_DECISIONS.md Phase 6.

components.description: NVIDIA inference through CUDA 12.4. A large optional pack; install it only if the Vulkan engine underperforms on your GPU.

components.name: Voice · espeak-ng
components.description: Grapheme-to-phoneme data for local text-to-speech. Required by the local voice engine; licensed GPL-3.0 and shipped separately from the base app.

components.name: Speech · Phonon-2
components.description: Offline dictation: a self-contained Python runtime plus the Phonon-2 English model. Large and optional; cloud speech or no speech works without it.
